features.title: WHAT AWAITS YOU ON THE SERVER

farm.title: Personal Farm
farm.description: Unique farm mechanics where you can raise animals and earn passive income.

instances.title: Instances
instances.description: Personal farm locations with delicious drops and a raid-boss at the end with varying difficulty levels.

mining.title: Mining
mining.description: Improve your mining skills, extract resources, and upgrade your equipment.

gear.title: Gear & Cosmetics
gear.description: Dozens of costumes and accessories, R-Grade and L-grade gear, and 3 tiers of epic jewelry — all enhancing your experience without affecting class balance.

fun.title: Bounty Hunting and Traitors of Legends
fun.description: Kill other players, take their adena, and for killing traitors you will get a bonus.

pvp.title: Automatic 1x1 PvP Tournament
pvp.description: Single-elimination tournament with no second chances: all skills are reset, enchantment capped at +6, full buff availables, top 3 places rewarded — CoL.

other.title: Explore the world of Legends
other.description: New mechanics, quests, high online play, various events, and personal tournaments will keep you entertained.

launch.title: Launch the Game
launch.description: Before launching, check for updates via launcher.exe
